## About
Longhorn Truck Tires is a commercial truck tire shop in Houston, TX. We mainly deal in new tires, and we also carry used tires, new and used wheels, and handle tire repair, brakes and shocks.
Whether you drive a dually truck, a box truck, a bus, an RV or a big rig, we stock tires to fit, from economy up to premium, so there is something for every budget. For fleets, we offer on-site fleet services, yard checks and mounted tire programs.
When a truck goes down, our road service crew works to get you back on the road as soon as possible. Customers give us a 4.7 rating from 122 Google reviews.

## Services
- New and used tires: New and used tires, along with tire repair.
- Tire repair, installation and balancing: Complete tire repair services, including tire installation and wheel balancing.
- New and used wheels: New and used wheels for your truck or trailer.
- Brakes, shocks, airbags and oil change: Repair work on brakes, shocks and airbags, plus oil change service.
- 24-hour road service: Road service for commercial trucks, aimed at getting you back on the road as soon as possible.
- Fleet services: On-site fleet services, yard checks and mounted tire programs.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of vehicles do you carry tires for?
A: Whether you have a dually truck, box truck, bus, RV or 18-wheeler truck, our stock covers it.

Q: How far will your road service travel?
A: We provide road service over a 100-mile radius from our shop.

Q: Do you offer financing?
A: Yes. We have a special financing program, and you can call us to ask about 0% interest free financing on your purchases.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, the shop is open Saturday from 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM.
